source.note: Substitutes for the plan's poly.pizza source (blocked by a Cloudflare challenge) with Quaternius's CC0 Medieval Village Pack (Dec 2020) on OpenGameArt: `Bell_Tower.fbx`. The plan row asks for a bell or clock tower; no free, reachable clock tower was found, so this is a bell tower. A three-storey stone tower with timber string courses and corbels, a front door with steps, an open belfry with a bronze bell under a red tiled gable roof with a bell dormer. The FBX carries real colours for all ten materials (no .blend needed). Sized to 17 m so the door is about 2 m tall, in the 12 to 20 m range of a village bell tower. Colours on noon, as the other buildings: warm stone wall with lighter blocks, dark-brown timber, red roof, cream gable plaster, dark glass, pink-and-red bell. Door faces +Z; static, no clips.
